upgrades.blurb: On collapse, some tiles turn yellow. Collecting all gifts from these tiles gives bonus Golden Gifts. Golden Gift payout increases with tile size and multipliers.

upgrades.blurb: On Collapse and on odd levels, the Medal spawns, bring it to the beacon for Golden Gifts and the option to pick a difficult curse for Golden Gifts. Choosing to pick a difficult curse increases future Golden Gifts rewards. Carrying it gives an extra double jump but disables abilities.

upgrades.name: Grace Wings
upgrades.blurb: Greatly enhances air control.
